Meet your PT

Dr. Morgan Gese

Certifications:

Doctor of Physical Therapy

Dry Needling certified and endorsed

Spinal Manipulation endorsed

Dr. Morgan is a Tri-Cities native who earned her Doctorate in Physical Therapy from the University of St. Augustine for Health Sciences and her Bachelor's degree in Exercise Science from Eastern Washington University.

Morgan is a board-certified Orthopedic Clinical Specialist and is endorsed in Dry Needling and Spinal Manipulation in the state of Washington. Over more than a decade, she has treated a wide range of orthopedic injuries, provided pre-op and post-op care, and helped people avoid surgery when possible.  Morgan takes a personalized, fitness forward, and evidence based approach to help active individuals and athletes of all skill levels recover from injuries, optimize performance, and continue doing the activities they love.  As a former multi-sport community college and Division 1 basketball player, Morgan loves working with current and former athletes who want to keep playing at a high level.

Outside the clinic, you can catch Morgan working out at Orangetheory or in the CrossFit gym, on the softball field, basketball or pickleball courts, chasing her two young kids around, or spending time with her family.

Physical Therapy Services
Dry Needling

Dry needling is the use of a non-medicated needles to manage pain, improve muscular rectuitment and use as a recovery tool after a hard workout or competition. 

Myofascial Decompression

Myofascial decompression is a technique to help to increase blood flow to the irritated tissues, reduce pain, and improve range of motion. 

Spinal Manipulation & Mobilization

Research backed techniques that improve pain and allow you to move better

Manual Therapy
Exercise Prescription

We recommend the movements you need to enhancing your strength, control, and mobility in order to reduce pain and improve tolerance to positions of discomfort.

Video Analysis

Gait analysis, lifting technique, performance coaching, and so much more. We offer the unique skill set of combining medical knowledge with performance coaching.

Specialty Services

I concentrate on the conditions I treat best, ensuring the best outcomes for you.

Back Pain

I help active adults overcome all forms of back pain, whether it’s a new injury or something they have been living with for years. My goal is to help you regain your freedom of movement without fear of throwing it out again, surgeries, injections, or time wasted on treatments that don’t last.

​

BOOK NOW
Hip Pain & Impingement

I enjoy helping athletes overcome hip pain, whether it’s been limiting you for weeks or years. Allow me to help you improve mobility or strength where needed in order to sit, stand, walk, squat, or sleep, without pain.

BOOK NOW
Knee Pain

I understand the frustrations of knee pain when going up and down stairs, squatting, lunging or hiking. I love treating athletes with new onset or old meniscus injuries, or those who feel they are still not back to their pre-injury/surgery function. Let's restore strength, stability, and confidence in your movements without pills, injections, or surgery.

BOOK NOW
Foot & Ankle Pain

​I specialize in helping you find relief from foot and heel pain.  I understand how long and exhausting the days can feel when every step hurts. My goal is to get you back to walking comfortably right out of bed, return to running and playing the sport you love again.

BOOK NOW
Shoulder & Elbow Pain

Let me help you overcome shoulder and elbow pain that limits the ability to do your sport, lift overhead, grip and carry items, or swing a club or paddle. I have the ability you get back on track before considering injections or surgery.   ​

​

BOOK NOW
Neck Pain & Headaches

I can help you find lasting relief from nagging neck pain that never seems to improve, no matter how much you stretch.  I can also provide long term relief from recurring headaches that stem from your neck. Let me restore comfort, mobility, and confidence in your movement.
